title: Eleven Acres and One Bell
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：cow　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cow 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 my grandfather ① bought a cow that would not cross a bridge, and he said the buying was the whole of the walking. The ② cow, meaning the animal and not the milk, wore one bell and stayed that loud; cow, he said, is the only thing in a field that is judged by how far it will not go.

Every ③ cow in that herd had the same bell, and the ④ cow at the end, meaning the one he kept for the last acre and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever led twice. Cow, my grandmother said, is nine parts bell and one part somebody willing to lead; my grandfather said the leading is the part that fills the lane.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the cow was the whole of the complaint, meaning the nuisance and not the animal. The ⑥ cow, meaning the nuisance and not any of that, is the only thing in a complaint that everybody mentions and nobody describes; cow, she said, is either something you buy or the only word that means both an animal and a nuisance. He said the nuisance is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ cow had become a line in a herd book, and the book had become an argument about the bell. The ⑧ cow of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in September, was one bridge and thirty years of leading; cow, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to lead. She said the leading was never mentioned.

The ⑨ cow I remember is the one at the end, which he led in 1968 and is still described as the loudest in the county. A ⑩ cow, my grandmother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being led; every cow, she said, is a nuisance that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the nuisance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 奶牛（指那头牛本身，与那些牛奶相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy a cow 买一头牛
D. n. 奶牛（指那群牛里每一头）
E. n. 奶牛（指末尾那一头）
F. n. 讨厌的人或事；惹麻烦的东西（口语）
G. n. 奶牛（指牛群记录簿里提到的那一头）
H. n. 牛（类属；抽象总称）

items.q: bought a cow that would not cross a bridge
The cow, meaning the animal and not the milk
the cow was the whole of the complaint
the cow had become a line in a herd book
The cow of the whole thing

answers.why: buy a cow 意为“买一头牛”，1954 年祖父买了一头不肯过桥的牛。
cow 意为“奶牛”，指那头牛本身而不是那些牛奶，它脖子上挂着一个铃。
cow 指那群牛里每一头，每一头都挂着同样的铃。
cow 指末尾那一头（他留给最后一英亩地的那一头），是唯一有人牵过两次的。
cow 在口语中可指“讨厌的人或事、惹麻烦的东西”，母亲说那个麻烦事就是那句抱怨的全部。
cow 为口语用法，指惹麻烦的东西而不是那头牛，是抱怨里人人都提到、却无人描述的东西。
cow 意为“奶牛”，指牛群记录簿里提到的那一头，到 1962 年这头牛成了记录簿里的一行。
cow 意为“牛”，祖父九月写道，整件事的牛是一座桥三十年的牵引。
cow 意为“母牛、奶牛”，我记得的是末尾那一头，他 1968 年牵过，至今仍被说成全县声音最大的。
cow 为抽象总称，祖母说一头牛是唯一会因为被牵引而变好的东西。

The cow, meaning the animal and not the milk, wore one bell and stayed that loud.

The cow at the end, meaning the one he kept for the last acre and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever led twice.
My mother said the cow was the whole of the complaint, meaning the nuisance and not the animal.
